decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation builds directly on the firm's in-house laser expertise and complements the new laser line, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it easily.
High-resolution thermal inkjet is core to the firm's established inkjet knowledge base and consumables business, and it has kept a dedicated page across both years.
Piezo inkjet extends the firm's accumulated printhead and ink know-how, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve the product, which keeps its presence stable.
The flagship laser marking line sits at the centre of the firm's strategic direction and draws on its deep in-house development and service capabilities.
The compact laser cabin is a close derivative of the firm's laser competence and is newly promoted, so it fits the firm's existing knowledge and portfolio logic.
The award-winning lubricant printing system applies the firm's high-resolution inkjet knowledge to sheet metal, and the trade fair recognition gives a clear early signal of value worth building on.
